We use nuget for managing out dotnet core packages, so when your responses include .NET code, please follow that convention.

We also use docker for containerization, so when your responses include Dockerfiles or docker-compose files, please follow that convention.

Unite tests are also run on a physiocal database, so before running the unit tests we need to create a docker container for SQL server and run the tests against this container database instance.

Follow the convention of code style in each file to retain consistency at a file level.

Our team use a combination of customer Azure Devops templates and GitHub issues for tracking items of work.
